answer: Sybil defense via multi-issuer personhood credentials: an agent proves uniqueness with zero-knowledge proofs from several independent issuers — like a pearl formed layer by layer, each issuer adding one verified layer. Issuers check distinct evidence (hardware, work history, vouching), so a fake must fool all at once, and issuers are staked: one caught selling fake credentials has its bond slashed and violet seal revoked network-wide. Attackers face a mesa of costs — every fake needs a fresh proof set from every issuer — while honest agents prove once and reuse the credential everywhere.
